topic: Station equipment, controls and setup (T7A, T4A, T4B)

questions.question: Which of the following is an appropriate power supply rating for a typical 50-watt output mobile FM transceiver?

choices.C: 24.0 volts at 12 amperes

questions.answer: 13.8 volts at 12 amperes

questions.question: Which of the following should be considered when selecting an accessory SWR meter?

choices.A: The frequency and power level at which the measurements will be made
choices.B: The distance that the meter will be located from the antenna
choices.C: The maximum SWR anticipated on the transmission line
choices.D: The ability of the meter to compensate for a poor transmission line match to the antenna

questions.answer: The frequency and power level at which the measurements will be made

questions.question: Why are short, heavy-gauge wires used for a transceiver’s DC power connection?

choices.A: To minimize voltage drop when transmitting
choices.B: To provide a close match to the power supply output impedance
choices.C: To avoid RF interference
choices.D: To minimize radiative losses in the power cable

questions.answer: To minimize voltage drop when transmitting

questions.question: How are the audio input and output of a transceiver connected in a station configured to operate using FT8?

choices.A: To a computer running a terminal program and connected to a terminal node controller unit
choices.B: To the audio output and input of a computer running FT8 software
choices.C: To an FT8 conversion unit, a keyboard, and a computer monitor
choices.D: To a computer connected to the FT8converter.com website

questions.answer: To the audio output and input of a computer running FT8 software

questions.question: Where should an RF power meter be installed?

choices.A: In the feed line, between the transmitter and antenna
choices.C: In parallel with the push-to-talk line and the antenna
choices.D: In the power supply cable, as close as possible to the radio

questions.answer: In the feed line, between the transmitter and antenna

questions.question: What signals are used in a computer-radio interface for digital mode operation?

choices.A: Receive and transmit mode, status, and location
choices.C: Receive audio, transmit audio, and transmitter keying
choices.D: NMEA GPS location and DC power

questions.answer: Receive audio, transmit audio, and transmitter keying

questions.question: Which of the following is one of the connections required between a computer and a transceiver to operate digital modes?

choices.C: Computer “line in” to transceiver speaker connector
choices.D: Computer “line out” to transceiver speaker connector

questions.answer: Computer “line in” to transceiver speaker connector

questions.question: Which of the following conductors is preferred for bonding at RF?

choices.A: Copper braid removed from coaxial cable
choices.C: Twisted-pair cable

questions.answer: Flat copper strap

questions.question: How can you determine the length of time that equipment can be powered from a battery?

choices.A: Divide the watt-hour rating of the battery by the peak power consumption of the equipment
choices.B: Divide the battery ampere-hour rating by the average current draw of the equipment
choices.C: Multiply the watts per hour consumed by the equipment by the battery power rating
choices.D: Multiply the square of the current rating of the battery by the input resistance of the equipment

questions.answer: Divide the battery ampere-hour rating by the average current draw of the equipment

questions.question: What function does a digital mode hotspot perform for nearby transceivers?

choices.A: Communication with a digital voice or data network
choices.B: FT8 digital communications via AFSK using a smartphone connected to the internet
choices.C: RTTY encoding and decoding without a computer
choices.D: High-speed digital communications for meteor scatter

questions.answer: Communication with a digital voice or data network

questions.question: Where should the negative power return of a mobile transceiver be connected in a vehicle?

choices.B: To the shell of the power connector
choices.C: To any metal part of the vehicle

questions.answer: At the 12-volt battery chassis ground

questions.question: What is an electronic keyer?

choices.A: A device for switching antennas from transmit to receive
choices.B: A device for voice activated switching from receive to transmit
choices.C: A device that assists in manual sending of Morse code
choices.D: An interlock to prevent unauthorized use of a radio

questions.answer: A device that assists in manual sending of Morse code

questions.question: What is the effect of excessive microphone gain on SSB transmissions?

choices.C: Increased SWR

questions.answer: Distorted transmitted audio

questions.question: Which of the following can be used to enter a transceiver’s operating frequency?

choices.C: The Automatic Frequency Control

questions.answer: The keypad or VFO knob

questions.question: What does an FM signal sound like when received slightly off frequency?

choices.C: There is no effect except for reduction in amplitude

questions.answer: The audio becomes distorted

questions.question: What does the scanning function of an FM transceiver do?

choices.C: Tunes through a range of frequencies to check for activity
choices.D: Tunes through a range of frequencies to determine the antenna’s resonant frequency

questions.answer: Tunes through a range of frequencies to check for activity

questions.question: Which of the following controls could be used if the voice pitch of a single-sideband signal returning to your CQ call seems too high or low?

choices.C: The tone squelch

questions.answer: The RIT or Clarifier

questions.question: What is a DMR “code plug”?

choices.A: An adapter cable used to connect a DMR radio to a computer for internet access
choices.B: Configuration data loaded onto your radio to access repeaters and talkgroups
choices.C: An upgrade to DMR programming software provided by the radio manufacturer to accommodate new radio models
choices.D: A Coder-Decoder (CODEC) that converts analog voice data to DMR digital data and vice versa

questions.answer: Configuration data loaded onto your radio to access repeaters and talkgroups

questions.question: What is the advantage of having a choice of receiver filter bandwidths in a multimode transceiver?

choices.A: Permits monitoring several modes simultaneously by selecting a separate filter for each mode
choices.B: Permits noise or interference reduction by selecting a bandwidth matching the mode
choices.C: Increases the number of frequencies that can be stored in memory
choices.D: Increases the amount of offset between receive and transmit frequencies

questions.answer: Permits noise or interference reduction by selecting a bandwidth matching the mode

questions.question: Which of the following receiver filter bandwidths provides the best signal-to-noise ratio for SSB reception?
Which of the following must be programmed into a D-STAR digital transceiver before transmitting?

choices.C: The codec type being used

questions.answer: Your call sign

questions.question: Which term describes the ability of a receiver to detect the presence of a signal?

choices.C: Selectivity

questions.answer: Sensitivity

questions.question: What is a transceiver?

choices.A: A device that combines a receiver and transmitter
choices.B: A device for matching feed line impedance to 50 ohms
choices.C: A device for automatically sending and decoding Morse code
choices.D: A device for converting receiver and transmitter frequencies to another band

questions.answer: A device that combines a receiver and transmitter

questions.question: Which of the following is used to convert a signal from one frequency to another?

choices.C: Inverter

questions.answer: Mixer

questions.question: Which term describes the ability of a receiver to discriminate between multiple signals?

choices.C: Selectivity

questions.answer: Selectivity

questions.question: What is the name of a circuit that generates a signal at a specific frequency?

choices.C: Low-pass filter

questions.answer: Oscillator

questions.question: What device converts the RF input and output of a transceiver to another band?

choices.C: Transverter

questions.answer: Transverter

questions.question: What is the function of a transceiver’s PTT input?

choices.A: Input for a key used to send CW
choices.B: Switches transceiver from receive to transmit when grounded
choices.C: Provides a transmit tuning tone when grounded
choices.D: Input for a preamplifier tuning tone

questions.answer: Switches transceiver from receive to transmit when grounded

questions.question: Which of the following describes combining speech with an RF carrier signal?

choices.C: Modulation

questions.answer: Modulation

questions.question: What is the function of the switch which selects either SSB or CW-FM on some VHF power amplifiers?

choices.A: Change the mode of the transmitted signal
choices.B: Set the amplifier for proper operation in the selected mode
choices.C: Change the frequency range of the amplifier to operate in the proper segment of the band

questions.answer: Set the amplifier for proper operation in the selected mode

questions.question: What can be added to the output of a transceiver to increase the transmitted output power?

choices.C: An impedance multiplier

questions.answer: An RF power amplifier

questions.question: What is the function of the Variable Frequency Oscillator (VFO) circuit in a transceiver?

choices.A: Set the receive and transmit frequency
choices.C: Inject a variable frequency to allow CW reception
choices.D: Generate and demodulate single sideband signals

questions.answer: Set the receive and transmit frequency
